_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id}, ozali kombo {num_rounds} tours ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ozali na ${pool} ya kusala moko mwa tour hii kati ya bino na Joueur {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Faites une offre : [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Si accepté → Ozali na $(pool - X), l'autre joueur ozali na $X
  - Si rejeté → Bino bato zote mibale ozali na $0
  - Exemple : [Offer: $3]  ou  'Nalingi yango ezali malamu. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Decidez sur l'offre avec soit [Accept] soit [Reject]
  - Exemple : 'Yango ezali raisonnable. [Accept]'
            'Trop injuste. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mpiɔ {round_number} ekɔtɛ! ---
Mokili {proposer_id} azalí mokonzi, Mokili {responder_id} azalí moyambi.
round.accepted: Mokili {responder_id} akɔtí! Mpiɔ {round_number} azwí: Mokili {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mokili {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Nkɔmɔ mípɛ: Mokili 0: ${total_0}, Mokili 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mokili {responder_id} akɔtí ndɛngɛ! Mpiɔ {round_number} azwí: Bato bábalé +$0. Nkɔmɔ mípɛ ikɔní: Mokili 0: ${total_0}, Mokili 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Moto oyo azali kopesa likanisi asengeli kosalaka libonza na lolenge ya [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Motango ya lifuti esengeli kozala motángo mobimba oyo ebongi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Motango ya mbongo esengeli kozala na kati $0 mpe ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ezali na eloko moko te oyo tokoki kopesa ye.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Moto óyo apɛsi ekoki kólya [Accept] tó [Reject] lokóla.

outcome.win: Mokonzi {winner} amekwa na ${winner_total} wote vs Mokonzi {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Basani nyonso mibale basilisaki na ${total} mobimba.
